listingTitle: Over The Door Hooks, Towel Holder for Bathroom, Door Mount Towel Rack Towel Hooks for Bedroom Beach Towels Bathrobe Wall Mount Hang on The Door Cabinet Cupboard Metal Sandblasted (Black)
listingLines: 【Two kinds of usage】: The towel rack is detachable. It can be assembled to hang on a door, or it can be disassembled and nailed to a wall. Two removable rods that can be removed in a very simple way without the need for any tools.

【Occasions】: Towel racks are suitable for bathrooms, kitchens, cupboards, living rooms, bedrooms, swimming pools, etc. Towel racks are great for hanging towels, bathrobes, coats, beach towels, bags, umbrellas, and kitchenware.
【Material】: Made of high quality high manganese steel, with black sand blasting, feel smooth, carving carefully, durable, waterproof and rustproof.
【Package】: 1 x Door mount towel rack, 3 x Rectangle sponge pads, 4 x screw anchors, 4 x screws. As shown in the picture.

【Size】: 15inchL x 1.7inchD x 10.3inchH (38cmL x 4.5cmD x 26.3cmH). For standard doors with a thickness of 1.7 inches (4.5 cm). To give you a good experience, we recommend hanging towel racks on doors between 1.4 and 1.7 inches (3.5-4.5cm) thick.
summary: This over-the-door hook rack provides convenient storage for towels, bathrobes, and coats. It offers a versatile solution for organizing items in various rooms without needing to drill into walls.
highlights: Features two installation options: hang on a door or mount to a wall.
Constructed from durable, waterproof, and rustproof high manganese steel with a black sandblasted finish.
Includes two removable rods for easy assembly and disassembly.
Suitable for standard doors between 1.4 and 1.7 inches thick.
stylingTips: Hang this black metal rack on the back of a bedroom door to keep robes and jackets off the floor.
Utilize the wall-mounting option in a small bathroom to free up counter space and hold frequently used towels.
Install in a kitchen cupboard door to hang dish towels and oven mitts, keeping them within easy reach.
beforeYouBuy: Measure your door thickness to ensure it is between 1.4 and 1.7 inches (3.5-4.5cm) for optimal hanging.
Confirm the dimensions of the rack (15"L x 1.7"D x 10.3"H) will fit your intended space.
Check the package contents to ensure all listed items, including the rack, sponge pads, screw anchors, and screws, are included.
